m15.text: Dovid is wounded at the battle of Child's Wall and lies feverish in the cathedral courtyard when Avacyn appears, and she and the angel Gryta summon him and order him to prepare the forbidden space of the Lofts of Thraben Cathedral.
He becomes Comitant Dovid, isolated from the cathars and church officials, and is given Eost, a sword forged from the Helvault, with his name at the top of the honored list.
In the cistern he finds a preserved, strangled man in black with a book in his coat, which he takes after sealing the body in a nameless crypt.
Dovid solves the Nightfall Cathars' spell on the journal, which says that Sorin created Avacyn and that the church keeps humans as livestock, and he concludes that his faith is a lie.
